title: Read JSON or fall back
hints: Use two separate try blocks: one around open()/read() that catches only FileNotFoundError, one around json.loads that catches only json.JSONDecodeError.
Read the text first, then `if not text.strip(): return default` handles the empty-file case before json sees it.
Return copy.deepcopy(default) instead of default; and build the ValueError message with f"{path}: ..." then `from e`.
